name: CX-to-CRM AI Promo Guard & Proactive Recovery

nodes.name: Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event
nodes.notes: Unified intake. Payload: source (aftership | sendcloud | trustpilot | zendesk), order_id, optional email and ticket_id, status, rating, message. Send carrier exceptions, 1-2 star reviews only, and every Zendesk ticket update (solved included).

nodes.name: Shopify: Lookup Order & Customer LTV
nodes.notes: Filtered lookup by order_id (Community-safe: set shopify_domain in payload or replace placeholder). Configure httpHeaderAuth with X-Shopify-Access-Token.

nodes.name: Resolve Customer Email & VIP Status

assignments.name: is_vip
assignments.value: ={{ (Number($json.orders?.[0]?.customer?.orders_count ?? $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.orders_count ?? 0) >= 3) || (Number($json.orders?.[0]?.customer?.total_spent ?? $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.total_spent ?? 0) >= 300) }}

assignments.name: event_summary
assignments.value: ={{ $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.message || $('Webhook: Carrier / Trustpilot / Zendesk Event').item.json.body.status || '' }}

nodes.notes: Computes resolved_email (webhook or Shopify order fallback), orders_count, total_spent, and is_vip (orders >= 3 OR total_spent >= 300 EUR).

nodes.name: Hold Window (Fixed Rules, No AI)
nodes.notes: Plain rules anyone can read: carrier exception 14 days, 1-2 star review 30 days, ticket 7 days after its latest update.

nodes.name: AI: Triage Urgency & Draft Empathy Reply (JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a Customer Experience triage assistant. Return strictly JSON: theme (not_received | product_quality | delivery_delay | customer_service | other), priority_tier (P0 | P1 | P2 | P3), owner_team (logistics_cs | product_quality | logistics | customer_service), internal_reply_draft (short empathetic draft in the customer language for a human agent; NEVER promise unapproved refunds or discounts), escalation_flags (array). Any mention of chargeback, bank dispute, legal threat, or VIP + stuck/lost parcel must be P0.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($('Resolve Customer Email & VIP Status').item.json) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Strict JSON contract: priority, theme, owner team and a draft. The pause length is not the AI's call: the fixed rules in the node before set it. The draft is saved ONLY as a private internal note.

nodes.name: Parse AI Triage Output (Safe Defaults)
nodes.notes: Real JavaScript Code node (n8n Community-safe try/catch). Supports OpenAI & Gemini outputs cleanly.

nodes.name: Klaviyo: Set Pause End Date

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { type: 'profile', attributes: { email: $('Resolve Customer Email & VIP Status').item.json.resolved_email, properties: { [$('Hold Window (Fixed Rules, No AI)').item.json.hold_property]: $('Hold Window (Fixed Rules, No AI)').item.json.hold_until, cx_hold_reason: $json.theme, cx_priority_tier: $json.priority_tier } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Writes one end date per kind of problem (cx_hold_until_delivery / _review / _ticket) on the profile found by resolved_email. The Klaviyo segment 'CX hold active' reads these dates, so nothing has to release the pause. API revision 2026-10-15; httpHeaderAuth with Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key YOUR_KEY.

nodes.name: Zendesk: Add Internal Note (Human-in-the-Loop Draft)
nodes.notes: Human-in-the-loop: the draft goes ONLY into a private internal note, never to the customer. Needs ticket_id in the event; without one (e.g. a carrier exception before the customer writes) this step fails softly (continue on fail) and the pause still applies.

nodes.name: Guard: Is P0 Critical or VIP?
nodes.notes: Escalates to #cx-vip-alerts if AI flagged P0 (e.g. chargeback/legal threat) OR Shopify confirmed VIP status (orders >= 3 or LTV >= 300 EUR).
